name: What if George Washington was a Girl?
source:
A historical visual novel about history's greatest heroes and villains and their trials and tribulations.

The story starts with the Dark Musician (Mozart) plotting to destroy Antarctica. Georgia Washington (George Washington) and Teddy Rosebelt (Theodore Roosevelt), knights of the United Nations were sent to stop the mad musical genius before the icy continent is lost forever.

BUT THEN, more stuff happens and there's intrigue and suspense and penguins? Find out more and meet other historical figures in this first chapter of an exciting new saga, Alter Historia.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2098470/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
一部关于历史上最伟大的英雄和恶棍以及他们的考验和磨难的历史视觉小说。

故事始于黑暗音乐家（莫扎特）密谋摧毁南极洲。联合国骑士乔治亚·华盛顿（乔治·华盛顿饰）和泰迪·罗斯贝尔特（西奥多·罗斯福饰）被派去阻止这个疯狂的音乐天才，以免冰冷的大陆永远消失。

但随后，更多的事情发生了，还有阴谋、悬念和企鹅？在激动人心的新传奇《Alter Historia》的第一章中，了解更多信息并结识其他历史人物。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2098470/]Steam[/url]]
